item.title: Modern Sleek Website Refresh
item.description:
250-750 CAD | The core structure, copy, and logo of my current site work well; what no longer feels right is the overall look and user flow. I want the same content presented in a modern, sleek aesthetic that instantly communicates professionalism and trust.
Scope of the redesign • Home, About, and Contact pages will all receive new layouts while retaining their existing text and imagery. • The logo must stay exactly as-is and continue to anchor the visual identity. • Visual hierarchy, typography, and colour palette are open for refinement so long as they complement the logo. • Responsive behaviour is essential—phone, tablet, and desktop views should be equally polished. • Page load speed and accessible navigation matter as much as the new styling because the site’s main purpose is to provide information clearly.
Deliverables 1. High-fidelity mock-ups (Figma, XD, or similar) for the three pages. 2. Final production-ready assets (CSS, images, font files) or, if using a CMS such as WordPress, a fully implemented theme update. 3. A short hand-over note outlining any new style guidelines and how to update sections in future.
Acceptance criteria • All existing copy and logo remain untouched. • Design matches the “modern and sleek” direction while avoiding visual clutter. • Mobile first: each page scores at least 90 on Google’s Mobile Lighthouse audit. • Internal links, forms, and contact details function exactly as on the current site.
All site files and admin access will be provided as soon as we agree on the timeline, and feedback will be prompt at each milestone so we can move quickly from concept to launch.

item.title: Modern WordPress Portfolio Build
item.description:
750-1500 USD | I’m looking for an experienced WordPress developer to build a clean, modern and professional website for my engineering consultancy specializing in fire safety for Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).
The website is aimed primarily at professional clients, project developers, operators and other stakeholders in the BESS industry. It should communicate technical expertise, reliability and experience rather than look like a typical creative portfolio.
The content, page structure, texts, images and most graphical elements are already prepared. I am mainly looking for professional WordPress implementation and refinement of the visual design.
What I need: • Implementation on my existing WordPress hosting/domain • Modern, technical and professional design with clear typography and generous spacing • Strong visual presentation using supplied BESS photographs, technical graphics and icons • Clear presentation of services, expertise and project experience • Responsive design for desktop, tablet and mobile • Fast loading times and lightweight implementation • Basic on-page SEO and security configuration • Contact section/form • Easy editing and maintenance after completion I prefer a clean, high-quality engineering/consulting look rather than a generic corporate template or creative portfolio style. Subtle animations are welcome where they improve the presentation, but the overall appearance should remain professional and technically credible. I am open to Gutenberg, Elementor, Bricks or another suitable solution, provided the website remains fast and easy to maintain. Please share examples of recent WordPress websites you have built, preferably for engineering, technology, energy, architecture or professional consulting businesses. Please also indicate your proposed approach, estimated timeline and what you would need from me to start.
The attached image is a visual concept/reference for the desired look and feel. It is not intended as a pixel-perfect final layout. The website content, images, texts and graphic elements will be provided separately.

item.title: Drone Spraying Service Website
item.description:
250-750 USD | I run a crop-care company that applies pesticides and nutrients by drone, and I now need a small yet polished online presence to explain the service and generate enquiries. The site is strictly informational—no online payments or bookings at this stage—so the focus is on telling our story, listing the benefits of aerial spraying, and making it easy for farmers to reach me.
Design & feel I like a modern, sleek aesthetic: full-width imagery of drones in action, clean typography, plenty of white space, and smooth scrolling effects that still load quickly on rural 4G connections. Think lightweight HTML5/CSS3 (or a fast WordPress theme such as Astra or GeneratePress) with responsive layouts that look just as sharp on mobile as on desktop.
Content structure The build only needs three pages for now: • Home – hero video or image, quick value proposition, call-to-action button to contact form • Services – outline of spray types, acreage capacity, safety and compliance details, plus a short FAQ section I will supply • Contact Us – embedded map, contact form (reCAPTCHA protected), phone, email, and operating hours
Technical notes • SSL-ready and GDPR-compliant form handling • Optimised images and basic on-page SEO (meta titles, alt tags) so we can rank locally • Delivery as a live site on my current hosting (cPanel access provided) plus a zipped backup
Acceptance criteria 1. Page load under 3 s on GTmetrix for 3G simulation 2. No console errors in latest Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge 3. Contact form successfully sends to my email and shows thank-you confirmation
Please include any relevant portfolio pieces of similarly styled sites when you reply, along with your estimated timeframe for the initial mock-ups and final launch.

item.title: Gas Engineer Services Website Build

Content I don’t have any copy prepared, so I’ll rely on you to create concise, SEO-friendly text for each service page plus a punchy home page introduction and calls-to-action. Content must follow UK Gas Safe guidelines and speak to homeowners and landlords in plain English.
Key deliverables • Responsive website (home + 3 service pages + contact page) • Original copywriting for every page • Contact or booking form routed to my email • Basic on-page SEO (meta titles, descriptions, H1/H2 tags) • Simple CMS hand-off with instructions
I’ll supply the logo, brand colours and Gas Safe registration details once we start. If anything’s unclear, just ask—I’m keen to get this online quickly.

item.title: Ongoing Monthly Artificial Intelligence Projects
item.description:
1500-3000 USD | ## AI Developer / AI Engineer – Ongoing Monthly Projects
We are looking for an experienced **AI Developer/Engineer** to work with us on an ongoing monthly basis to help design, prototype, and build AI-powered solutions.
This is not a single-project engagement. We have a growing pipeline of AI initiatives and are looking for someone who can become a long-term technical partner, working with us each month to take ideas from concept to working solutions.
### What You'll Work On
Projects will vary month to month and may include:
* Building AI agents and agentic workflows * Developing applications using LLMs such as OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini * Connecting AI to existing applications, APIs, databases, and business systems * Building RAG/search and knowledge-based AI solutions * Creating AI-powered automation for internal business processes * Rapidly prototyping new AI product ideas * Evaluating new AI models, tools, frameworks, and technologies * Improving existing AI applications for accuracy, speed, reliability, and cost
### What We're Looking For
We want someone who is comfortable being given a business problem rather than a perfectly defined technical specification.
You should be able to help us think through the solution, recommend an approach, rapidly build a prototype, and then turn successful prototypes into production-ready solutions.
Experience with **LLMs, APIs, AI agents, RAG, Python and/or .NET, databases, cloud infrastructure, and modern AI development tools** is preferred.
Most importantly, we're looking for someone who is highly technical, moves quickly, experiments with new technology, and genuinely enjoys building with AI.
### Engagement
This will be an **ongoing monthly freelance engagement**. We expect to have multiple AI projects throughout the year and would like to establish a consistent relationship with someone who can dedicate capacity to us each month.
When applying, please include examples of AI applications or agents you have personally built, the technologies/models you used, your role in building them, and your expected monthly availability and rate.

item.title: Build a Bilingual Healthcare E-commerce Platform on Shopify
item.description:
250-750 USD | Project: Build a Bilingual Healthcare E-commerce Platform on Shopify looking for an experienced developer or small agency to design and build a professional e-commerce platform for the Saudi market.
The platform will serve two customer groups:
1. Healthcare professionals — online store
Sell products such as handheld ultrasound devices, stethoscopes, scrubs, medical bags and professional essentials.
Required features:
* English and Arabic, including proper right-to-left layouts. * Premium, mobile-friendly design aligned with our brand. * Product categories, search, filters, product pages, cart and checkout. * Saudi payment gateway integration and Tamara, subject to merchant approval and technical compatibility. * Shipping, order tracking, returns and an agreed Saudi e-invoicing integration. * Verified employee accounts with controlled discounts and restricted pricing. * Demo booking, quotation requests and assisted purchasing for high-value devices.
2. B2B — used medical equipment
featuring:
* Equipment listings with specifications, condition reports, photographs and supporting documents. * Buyer registration and approval. * Enquiries, quotation requests and manually reviewed offers. * Requests for inspection, cleaning, data wiping, logistics and installation services. * Admin approval before listings are published, with an audit trail. * Clearly identified sellers and approved payment arrangements; no platform-held wallet or escrow in the initial release.
Public e-auctions and third-party seller onboarding in case if seller wants to.
Platform and delivery
Shopify is preferred. Please identify what can be delivered through standard functionality, paid apps and custom development, including any plan limitations.
The scope should include design, development, testing, launch, basic SEO and analytics, admin training, documentation and post-launch support. All accounts, custom code and configuration must be handed over to Flow.
Please include in your proposal:
* Two or three relevant live projects and your role in delivering them. * Recommended architecture and proposed apps/integrations. * Fixed-price breakdown, milestones and delivery timeline. * All recurring subscription and maintenance costs. * Assumptions, exclusions, support terms and defect-warranty period.
Payments will be linked to agreed deliverables and acceptance testing. Detailed requirements and brand assets will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

I’ll stay on call to answer questions and deliver any extra assets immediately after you accept the project, and I’m ready to sign off as soon as the live store looks and works exactly like the designs.

item.title: Complete and Launch a Redesigned WordPress Website
item.description:
250-750 GBP | I am looking for an experienced WordPress freelancer to complete and launch a redesigned website
This is not simply a visual design job. The existing website has Google and Bing search history and backlinks that must be protected during the relaunch.
The selected freelancer will implement approved content, complete the WordPress build, preserve important URLs, configure redirects, fix technical SEO issues, install GA4 and lead tracking, test the enquiry process and manage the launch.
Main responsibilities Finish and quality-check the staging website Implement supplied page content Preserve approved live URLs Implement and test a supplied redirect plan Configure titles, descriptions, headings and canonical URLs Correct robots.txt, sitemap and indexability at launch Remove all staging-domain references Configure GA4 and Google Tag Manager where appropriate Track successful enquiries using generate_lead Connect GA4 with Google Search Console Test forms, email delivery, audio players and CTAs Improve mobile usability, accessibility and performance Submit the new sitemap to Google and Bing Monitor the site immediately after launch Provide written handover and a short screen-recorded walkthrough Required experience
Applicants should have demonstrable experience with:
WordPress website launches Website migrations involving existing organic search traffic Technical SEO and URL redirects Google Search Console Bing Webmaster Tools GA4 and Google Tag Manager Form conversion tracking Page-speed optimisation Mobile and accessibility testing WordPress backup and rollback procedures
Experience with voiceover, audio, creative-service or lead-generation websites would be useful but is not essential.
Important requirements Do not change established URLs without approval. Do not install unnecessary plugins. Do not use mass-produced AI content. Do not remove pages solely because they look old. Do not disavow backlinks without evidence of a manual-action risk and written approval. Do not promise guaranteed rankings. All accounts, properties, licences and data must remain under my ownership. The freelancer must use an individual account rather than my primary administrator login.
What to include in your proposal Please provide:
Two or three relevant WordPress projects. An example of a site migration or relaunch where organic search traffic had to be protected. Your experience with GA4 lead tracking. How you would test redirects and indexability before launch. Your proposed project stages and timescale. A fixed-price quotation, with optional costs listed separately. To prove you've read this far and are not giving a generic response, tell me your favourite meal in the first line of your reply. What post-launch support is included.
Generic proposals that do not address SEO migration and conversion tracking will not be considered.

item.title: Custom E-Commerce Website Build
item.description:

item.title: WordPress Dev for Multi-platform Travel Blog

Scope of Work
1. WordPress Migration/Rebuild — Rebuild/migrate the existing Hostinger site into a proper self-hosted WordPress installation while preserving my domain, business email, useful existing content, links, and brand assets.
2. Professional Redesign — Create a modern, attractive, mobile-responsive travel/review website that feels personal to the Unfiltered With Rose brand—not like a generic template or AI-generated travel blog. (I would prefer to keep the exact same layout that you currently see with the color scheme and all)

5. Reusable Travel Content System — Create reusable templates/categories for travel articles, destinations, hotels/resorts, cruises, restaurants/experiences, reviews, guides/tips and similar future content. I should not have to design a new page every time I publish.
6.SEO & Google Setup — Configure technical/on-page SEO, titles/meta descriptions, sitemap, schema where appropriate, internal linking, Google Search Console and Google Analytics.

8. Affiliate Monetization — Make the site affiliate-ready with disclosures, reusable CTA/link areas and an organized method for managing travel-related affiliate links.
9. Facebook Integration & Automation — Connect my Facebook presence to the content workflow so approved website content can be repurposed/scheduled without manually recreating every post.
10. YouTube Integration & Workflow — Optimize/connect the YouTube side of the brand and establish a repeatable system for video/Shorts-related titles, descriptions, keywords, links, thumbnails/templates and content repurposing.
11. Social Scheduling System — Establish one central, manageable scheduling/distribution workflow for the appropriate social channels rather than requiring me to log into each platform separately.
12. Content Repurposing Automation — Where practical, one approved core piece of content should be reusable across the ecosystem: website → social → Facebook → YouTube supporting content/Shorts → email/newsletter, with human approval where appropriate.
13. Email & Newsletter Automation — Configure branded email capture, subscriber management, welcome automation and a reusable newsletter/content-distribution system.
14. Automation Integrations — Connect WordPress and the approved social/email/content tools using reliable integrations or automation platforms. The objective is maximum practical automation without creating an unnecessarily expensive or fragile technology stack.
15. Security, Backups & Maintenance — Configure security/hardening, SSL, spam protection, backups, updates and a straightforward recovery process.
16. Analytics & Reporting — Configure an easy way for me to review website traffic, search performance, top content, referral/social traffic and available monetization data without constantly checking numerous systems.
After work is completed:
1. Full Account & Asset Ownership — I retain ownership/control of my domain, hosting, WordPress installation, Google properties, Facebook, YouTube, email list, automation accounts, content, graphics, integrations, source files and any licenses/accounts purchased specifically for this project.
2. Documentation & Training — Provide documentation plus a recorded video walkthrough showing how the system works, what is automated, how I approve/publish content, how to make normal edits, and what requires occasional maintenance.
3. Complete End-to-End Testing — Before final acceptance, we will test the actual workflow—not merely inspect the website. This includes website publishing/display, mobile responsiveness, SEO configuration, analytics, social/Facebook workflow, YouTube workflow, email workflow, automations and backups.
Tools / Software:
I am open to premium software when it provides meaningful value, but I do not want unnecessary overlapping subscriptions.
Possible tools may include WordPress-compatible SEO software, Google Search Console/Analytics/AdSense, Metricool or a comparable social scheduling platform, vidIQ or comparable YouTube optimization tools, an email/newsletter platform, and an appropriate automation platform.
You may recommend alternatives if they produce a better or simpler system such as one consolidated system.
Non-Negotiable
All permanent accounts should be created under my email/account ownership whenever possible. The freelancer may receive collaborator/admin access as needed but should not permanently own any essential component of the business. At project completion, all temporary access must be removed or reduced appropriately, and I must receive all necessary credentials, files, licenses, documentation and backups. Do not migrate my domain or business email in a way that risks interruption without discussing the migration plan with me first.
Please identify in your proposal:
-What tools/plugins you recommend (monthly cost) -Why each paid tool is necessary -I want the smallest reliable stack, not the largest. -Please include examples of WordPress websites you personally built, especially travel/content/affiliate websites if available. -Also briefly explain your experience with WordPress migration, website performance, SEO, Google integrations, social automation, Facebook, YouTube, email automation and content repurposing. -What would still require manual approval/work from me? -How would you migrate/rebuild the current site without disrupting my domain or business email? -How would you make the website faster? -How would you connect WordPress, Facebook, YouTube and email without creating a complicated system? -What is your estimated completion timeline? -What do you need from me before starting?
